approvers: Nobody, I decide alone, and the answer is no
reason: I pay about €12 a m² today with my own men and film, and you want €19 plus a deposit, a minimum job size and your approved applicator. I spend under €900 a year on this, so it is not worth changing how I work.
objection: It costs more than what I do now, it is a small spend for me anyway, and in July and August with the façade in full sun I do not trust a sprayed coating to go on and come off cleanly.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and plastic sheet with tape, applied by my own labour, from the same suppliers I have used for years.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or below what I pay now, plus a job I can walk and see where it came off clean from the sun-baked frames, with no deposit.
